high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "zoyasharmakumar," posted 21 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The photo captures a nighttime scene featuring a suspension bridge illuminated with lights. The bridge spans across a body of water, and its structure is highlighted by numerous lights strung along the cables and supports. The sky above the bridge is dark, indicating that it is either dusk or night. The lighting from the bridge creates a warm glow against the cool tones of the evening sky.
